svg: Why enterprises hesitate to deploy AI — 7 trust dimensionsData security"Where does our data go?"GDPR: up to 4% of global revenue.Access control"Can the AI reach data this user shouldn’t?"Auditability"How do we prove compliance to a regulator?"Reliability"What if it hallucinates?"95% accuracy ≈ 500 bad/day per 10k requests.Explainability"Why did it decide that?"ROI uncertainty"Show me hours saved, not AI hype."Change resistance"Will this replace my team?"
